summary: Recovery drains paused jobs via immutable (created_at, id) keyset pagination replacing the hard 100-cap; atomic single-statement claim/refresh predicates; no schema migration and existing repository ordering preserved. Lifecycle card capture is off the job's critical path (heartbeat starts before any provider I/O; capture is bounded/non-blocking and best-effort) so notification latency cannot stall execution or hold a lease.
residual_risks: Recovery sweep is bounded per capability update; drains to completion via keyset cursor.
